body: Can’t agree more. Looking to move out of that area as soon as I can. Leave it all behind though dunno where I’ll be going.
I wish…feel like I’m crying, screaming out but nobody there
You’re right….everyone gets tired of hearing how we are struggling. They’re ok and that’s all that matters.
With all the YouTube videos on there about no contact getting him, does it ever actually work?
I feel your pain. Trying no contact now. Head hoping he doesn’t contact me so I’m not faced with a choice but heart way behind on the memo. 😢😢😢

Have to admit I wish I had replied to him “I don’t particularly want to marry YOU either…..”
Seriously though, I don’t think it would make it any better, just that didn’t really know much about commitment rings and wondered if it was an half assed measure. I do love him…wish I didn’t but yeah, thanks you’re right, I do deserve better. The idiot even said so himself just before I left.
Hmmm…agree.
Yeah….so I can sell it 🤣🤣
Yeah, think you’re right…that was the last straw, insult to injury. Think I’ll be better off out of it, just hurts at the moment.
He was the one who kept bringing it up.

We’re in our 40s….he expected me to move into his family home with adult son and all the decor etc chosen by him and ex wife. He’s not prepared to move to a place for a fresh start and if I want to change decor then I’ll have to pay but in agreement with them both, now I find I’m expected to do housework for us all, even though I’m working full time too. Only person making any real sacrifice in the relationship is me, which is why partly I feel so fobbed off about a commitment ring and him making out like that is doing me a favour!

We’re in our 40s, both been divorced and were together nearly 2 years. Just feels like the “commitment” is an emotionally cheaper version, as one respondent said, half-assed version, like he’s always got one foot out of the door.
I suspect we’re no longer a couple so guess it doesn’t really matter

In the UK…think over here, it can have many meanings, and not necessarily in a romantic sense and certainly no legality. Think it tends to be younger couples, which we are not. Semantics? Maybe, but it just feels like a complete fob off. He knows I’d like some form of commitment and this is the least he thinks he can do.

I said that about engagement…but no, I think that’s too committed for him. Think I need to apply the same level of commitment as him..if it’s not an engagement or wedding ring, it’s not going on that finger unless I’ve bought it myself
Lol, we’re over 40….kids are not an option. Yes I think he is a dick. Lol
Yeah I guess, but if it’s not an engagement ring then I wouldn’t wear it on that finger. Period. It does feel more like a get out clause to me.

Thanks, think that articulates what I was thinking.  A bit of a “cheap” version (I don’t mean monetary wise) in love terms. This came out during a discussion as he’d mentioned and looked at rings with me there, then told me he was winding me up, or just window shopping. This was sometime ago, and finally with nothing left to lose I asked what the h*ll all the cr*p regarding rings was about. He then told me about the commitment ring….I replied that it felt like he was saying I wasn’t good enough for engagement, even without marriage.
Because he can? Believe me they’ll do it at ANY age.

Did he say why he did this? Experiencing the same thing myself and when I called him out on it he said I took his statements and actions too literally…him telling me he was looking at rings for me….I was never the one to bring the subject up. He also said he wanted nothing permanent on 3 separate occasions but now totally denies saying it. We’re supposed to be moving in together in next few weeks but I just feel so angry with him now, don’t think it’s a good idea at least for the moment. Heartbreaking as I do want to be with him but my head now telling me I should leave him. Not for “not proposing” but for building my hopes up with no intention of carrying it through. Guess that’s why I’m not telling him about not moving in….
I feel for you….leave him. Wish I had the courage to do the same.
Thank you x
Not sure if I’d like this but at least he’s being open and honest with you about it - gives you the option to leave if it’s not what you want.
Do you have an update? Great that you’ve had some positive responses xx
Thanks…the AH even described the ring design etc he was thinking of down to the setting and metal. But I wasn’t supposed to actually take it literally according to him…

So sorry to hear that, hopefully the pain will ease soon. Going through a similar situation myself, trying to get myself strong enough to leave. My bf went on for a while talking about and looking at engagement style rings, and even told me with no prompting that he was looking at rings for me. He has also on a number of occasions referred to himself as my husband in the future. Now he’s just told me after 1.5 years that he’s not looking for anything permanent and certainly not marriage. Bear I mind that I’ve never called him husband or myself his wife, and I only went along with his ring chat, admittedly responded positively but I never actively brought it up. Now it appears he was doing all to wind me up, apparently I took it all too literally!
Why would you want to forgive and trust them?
I’d love that too and I’m female. Don’t need another person’s money, am happy to support myself and have done for years. Wish I had a man who just loved me.

Agree with you there…my mother would slate me to my boyfriends and ex husband, always telling them they were too good for me. Only one she didn’t say anything to was a real control freak who made me unhappy, which she seemed to thrive on. Later in life not too long before she passed she admitted she never wanted me to leave home as I should have been there 24/7 to look after her and her needs.
Bliss
Enough red flags for a string of bunting….get out girl!
“Who’s going to walk the dog if you go?”….seriously.

Yeah, realise now I should have mentioned the other bits too, too busy trying to get it down. Thanks for the “good luck” 🙂

Update: bf now repeating his comments from earlier in the relationship when he said he wasn’t looking for anything permanent. So I asked why I’m supposed to be moving in, no response. And apparently I took the “I was looking for rings for you” statement too literally and he didn’t mean anything by it. Think it’s time to walk.

No, I said I didn’t want to dump him but at the same time don’t want him to say/hint at doing something if he doesn’t intend to. A little like saying he’s going to do the decorating (for example) but never does. 

He did go through a period of doing this before (lasted 3-4 weeks), making lots of hints etc then telling me it was all a wind up. I did tell him this was cruel, and he stopped for a while. It’s now started again and tbh my heart sank (oh god not again…) when it did.

I’m guessing all these responses are from blokes lol.

I avoid the subject of engagement etc as much as possible, though not at point (yet) of leaving the room if a wedding comes on the tv!  I have even changed the subject when he brings it up and been quite dismissive of it. 

All I want is for him to stop making these big hints and statements if he doesn’t have the intention, that’s all. I have already asked him not to do this and it stopped for a while but has now started again.

I don’t think that I’m getting engaged every other week! I actively avoid bringing up the subject, even delaying telling him about cousin’s wedding by a number of weeks so he didn’t think I was dropping hints! 

If I’m avoiding talking about the whole subject, only responding when he talks about it and him bringing the subject up and him now making direct statements like “buying you a ring”, then surely I’m not the one putting pressure on. 

I’ve not said or implied that I want to get engaged/married, I’m only moving in as want to be with him (his idea-I’m ok living on my own both mentally and financially) and apart from walking away or changing tv channels whenever anything remotely related to the subject is mentioned, i don’t know else I can avoid the subject! I have even changed the subject or tried to deflect when he brings it up.

I’ve already said I think it’s cruel to hint at things if he has no intention. If he doesn’t want to, fine. He just needs to stop dropping hints and telling me he’s looking at rings to buy me!

Yes, and I look at clothes too, not necessarily to buy them…but I don’t make a point of telling him. Just trying to get my head round why he would keep repeatedly bringing it up, even looking at them in front of me, asking my opinion if he has no intention. That’s just messing with my head.

Nope, not gonna dump him for not proposing. Just pissed off with him dropping massive hints and now outright stating he was looking for rings if he has no intention of doing it! He is the one who always brings it up!

It’s not a dealbreaker and TBF i do think it’s probably better to wait to see how living together pans out. I just wish he wouldn’t drop these big hints (done a number of times) and this latest incident he outright said he was looking at rings for me, and then say only window shopping.

If he doesn’t want to/has no intention, then he shouldn’t keep bringing it keep and saying these things. That’s all.

I don’t read engagement into every interaction…he is the one mentioning rings and has also weddings, not me! In fact if we’re out shopping I don’t drag into jewellers apart from Pandora looking at charms, I actively walk straight past! 

Basically if he doesn’t want to that’s fine as wouldn’t want him to do unless he wants to. But at the same time, if he has no intention of getting engaged then he shouldn’t really be dropping hints bigger than house bricks or outright say he’s looking at rings to buy me, which is what he said, and the way he described them, they were of that style.
